limitations: Machine simulation drives 50 MHz directly; PLL, HPS, DDR and physical I/O are excluded.

Audio numerical/command tests do not establish analog sound fidelity.
Game-ROM audio activity is smoke coverage only; independently calibrated per-game references are absent.
